ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white central field vs. low-intensity black borders; approximate 7:3 pixel ratio observed across the ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white pigmentation across 70% of the visible surface; black pigmentation localized to the entire leading edge, trailing edge, and tips; distinct dark oval macula isolated on the left lobe upper-central field; granular black mottling concentrated around the median notch vertex.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; interior angle measured at approximately 55 degrees; notch depth comprises approximately 15% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude increases on the distal third of each lobe lobe; edge is characterized by numerous micro-indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curvature on distal lobes, with trajectory flattening slightly as it approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white circular clusters (0.5-2.0% fluke width) on black distal tips, most prominent on the right lobe apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense white scarring and tissue irregularity on the distal right fluke tip; minor irregular indentation on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark 'island' pigmentation mark located at the upper-mid section of the left lobe's white field.
